text: Implemented in Python using only the standard library (http.server + sqlite3), no third-party deps
Create post (POST) with JSON body, returns created post (201)
Read: list posts and get single post by id; 404 for missing
Update post (PUT/PATCH) with JSON body; 404 for missing
X-API-Key header authentication; missing/wrong key rejected with 401/403
JSON request bodies; invalid JSON / missing fields rejected with 400
JSON responses with Content-Type application/json, including errors
Unknown routes return 404 JSON, server does not crash on bad input
